_doc: The valley town's people (#756, No Law step 1; docs/missions/BUILD_ORDER.md 0.3): who's in town when, where they stand or sit, and the few props they need, read by ValleyFolk (src/people/valley_folk.gd). A point is `lot` + `at` [a, b]: a metres east of the lot's west side (its x0), b metres back from the street front (north lots: -z, south lots: +z); y the ground's (plus `up`). `hours` [from, to] the clock's hours they're in town (to < from: past midnight). Come in while you watch (the clock running into `from`) and a man walks in from his `from` place by the town's ways (ValleyTown.add_ways plus this file's `places`); the clock set past it (a jump, a load at night) and he's at his post already. Past `to` he walks back out to his `from` and is gone. Sean's B on #755 (unanswered: B by default): the saloon stays a grey block, so the bar, the card table and the drinking are in the saloon's yard (saloon_annex, Sean #700) for now; when the spec saloon goes onto its lot (A, or #695's week) the set moves inside and the people with it.
status: PROPOSED (#756): who and where are this session's stand-ins; No Law's card (docs/missions/no-law.md) names the barman, the card player and the red shirt.

set._doc: The saloon yard's stand-in bar and card table. `bar`: the kit bar's middle, running along the yard (b) with its customers' side east (+x, `yaw` 90); `table`: the card table's middle, `chairs` its four chairs by compass round it (each facing the table); `lamps` lit oil lamps (OilLamp, lit 17-4) on the bar's and the table's tops.

places._doc: The set's own places, added to the town's ways for the folk: each [a, b] in the set's lot and what it links to (another of these, or the nearest of the town's places with `nearest`).

people.name: Barkeep
people._doc: The barman behind the bar (No Law: "Jesus, Cody, my chair!"). Comes out of the saloon's door.

people.name: Miner
people._doc: A drinker at the bar, in from the hotel.

people.name: Rancher
people._doc: A drinker at the bar, in from Back Street by the North-South Street.

people.name: Earl
people._doc: At the card table (the card cheat's Earl: No Law's card player). In from Back Street through the yard.

people.name: Drifter
people._doc: Across the card table from Earl. The north and south chairs stay free (the seated player's, the next step).

people.name: Cody
people._doc: Cody, who kills Earl (No Law beat 3, #773): one of the Baron's hired guns, a rough man. Not the red shirt (Sean on #796, 2026-11-11: the red shirt, who shot the sheriff, is another man and isn't in the saloon), so no red shirt on him. No hours: built with the rest and kept out till the act (NoLawMurder) takes him. A stand-in: the blacksmith's model (grey-blue work shirt) till the characters lane makes Cody.

people.name: Stranger
people._doc: The stranger who sits in the free chair and tells you not to move (No Law beat 3, #773). A stand-in man.

people.name: Townsman
people._doc: By day on the hotel's walk (No Law's scripts, docs/scripts/no_law.json: the townsman). Tells you the town's news: the sheriff shot (once he's brought in), and the morning after, Earl's murder as the town has it, or that you were sat at the table.

people.name: Loudmouth
people._doc: By day on the saloon's walk (the scripts' loudmouth): last night's bravado gone sour the morning after.

people.name: Undertaker
people._doc: On his walk by day. The morning after, Earl's laid out with him (ValleyFolk's morning: the body taken from the yard, a recorded death).

people.name: Townsman
people._doc: The young man the doctor sends to find you on day 2 (SheriffDies: "Harlan! Doc's asking for you.").

people.name: Sheriff
people._doc: The sheriff on the doctor's cot, day 2 (SheriffDies): the road's man (the_sheriff.json's model), built with the folk (a Studio man built in play is a long frame).

people.name: Doc
people._doc: The doctor (the_sheriff.json's), day 2: at his door for you, then in the sick room.

people.name: Mrs.
people._doc: The sheriff's wife at his bedside, day 2. A stand-in: the widow's model (the characters lane's), only used here.

talk._doc: What the day folk say when you pass (`says` names a set here): within `near_m` of you, one line each `gap_s` at most, the first entry whose `if` the story holds (StoryState facts: a value, a list of values, "*" set at all, a key with ! not set), its words in turn. Each entry's id is its line in the scripts (docs/scripts/no_law.json, on PR #837's branch till it merges).

townsman._doc: PROPOSED (#796): not in the scripts yet.
words: Sheriff's gone, then. And Doc's pinned his star on you. Well. Somebody had to.
Deputy, is it? You'll want to keep out of Cody's way.
You were sat right there at the table, they say. And you never moved.
Cody shot Earl dead over the cards. Said there's no law left to save him. Bold as brass.
Earl drew first, I heard. Or reached, anyhow.
Three shots, they say. Or two. Nobody counted.
Sheriff's shot, they say. Laid up at the doc's.
Who's to keep the peace now? Not me.
I'm putting the bar on my door tonight.

loudmouth._doc: PROPOSED (#796): not in the scripts yet.
words: Him? Deputy? Cody'll eat him for breakfast.
Sheriff's dead and they give the star to a drifter. God help us.
And who's to take Cody in? The sheriff's dying.
He'll be back, you watch. Nobody to stop him.

undertaker._doc: PROPOSED (#796): not in the scripts yet.
words: Two in two days. The sheriff gets the good box; the county's paying for that one.
Earl. Shot through the head, before witnesses, by the man Cody. Pine box. Nobody's paying for a stone.

morning._doc: No Law's morning after (#796): once the murder's done (nolaw.murder done) and the clock's in `hours` (it can only get there through the night), nolaw.morning is set. Earl's body, if he's dead, is taken to the undertaker's once you're `unseen_m` off it or it's out of your view: gone from the yard for good, StoryState nolaw.earl = undertaker and death.earl his record. From `sheriff_from` (the clock) the dying sheriff's scene (SheriffDies, config/moments/sheriff_dies.json) starts, once.
morning.earl_death: Earl, the card player. Shot through the head by Cody at the saloon's card table, the night after the sheriff was shot; a yard full of witnesses, and nobody stopped him. Laid out at the undertaker's.
